product.title: West Glacier & Polebridge Scenic Driving Tour

description.text: Discover the North Fork on a private full-day driving tour to Polebridge Mercantile, Bowman Lake, and West Glacier highlights tailored to your party. Your guide adjusts the route for wildlife stops, bakery time in Polebridge, and short hikes while handling all park navigation and entrance logistics.

highlights: Private full-day tour for your party only
Polebridge Mercantile and North Fork scenic drive
Bowman Lake and West Glacier viewpoint stops
Flexible itinerary with guide-customized wildlife and photo stops
Park entrance fees and private transport included

start.description: Private pickup from Whitefish, Columbia Falls, or West Glacier lodging. Your guide confirms timing and preferred North Fork stops before departure.

end.description: Return to your original pickup location after the Polebridge area loop.

product.itinerarySummary: Discover the North Fork on a private full-day driving tour to Polebridge Mercantile, Bowman Lake, and West Glacier highlights tailored to your party.

itineraryItems.title: West Glacier
itineraryItems.description: Depart West Glacier toward the North Fork entrance with an overview of the day's route.

itineraryItems.title: Polebridge
itineraryItems.description: Visit Polebridge Mercantile for huckleberry treats and a break in this remote gateway community.

itineraryItems.title: Bowman Lake
itineraryItems.description: Scenic stop at Bowman Lake with time for shoreline photos and optional short walks.

itineraryItems.title: Lake McDonald
itineraryItems.description: Return-route stop at Lake McDonald if time and conditions allow.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the West Glacier & Polebridge Scenic Driving Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 8 to 10 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from near Glacier National Park?
faqs.answer: Private pickup from Whitefish, Columbia Falls, or West Glacier lodging. Your guide confirms timing and preferred North Fork stops before departure.
